title: Miniatura Llamativa de Revelación de Secreto con Expresión de Sorpresa
prompt: Design an eye-catching 'secret reveal' style thumbnail. Main character: Use the person from the image with shocked expression covering mouth. Position: Person in bottom right corner, occupying 1/3 of frame. Background: Dark gradient (deep blue to black) creating mysterious atmosphere. Visual elements: Top left glowing 'forbidden' or 'classified file' icon, scattered question marks (?) and exclamation points (!), spotlight effect on central text area. Text hierarchy: Top small red text: '99% Don't Know This', Central extra-large yellow text: 'The Ultimate Truth Revealed', Bottom white small text: 'Number 3 Shocked Me...' Effects: Add subtle red alert border, blurred glow effects.
